        n_agents=1,
        opponents={},

        ladder={name: _open_runs(players[name]) for name in targets.ladder},

import importlib.util
from collections.abc import Callable, Mapping
from pathlib import Path

import pytest

from rllab.core import Agent, Env, RunSettings
from rllab.evaluate import EvalSpec, ScoreSet, eval_seeds
from rllab.lab import replay
from rllab.runs import GameRecording, RunRecord

pytestmark = pytest.mark.unit

CONTRACTS = Path(__file__).parents[2] / "contracts"
_spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("contracts_codec", CONTRACTS / "codec.py")
assert _spec is not None
assert _spec.loader is not None
codec = importlib.util.module_from_spec(_spec)
_spec.loader.exec_module(codec)


def _record() -> RunRecord:
    return codec.sample("runs.RunRecord", "corridor_complete", RunRecord)


class NewGameDoubles:
    """Stands in for load_player, make_env and evaluate; records what they got."""

    def __init__(self, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch, record: RunRecord) -> None:
        self.record = record
        self.loaded: list[tuple[str, int]] = []
        self.envs: list[RunSettings] = []
        self.specs: list[EvalSpec] = []
        self.agents: dict[str, Agent] = {}
        raw = codec.samples("evaluate.evaluate")["scripted_seed0"]
        self.game = codec.build(GameRecording, raw["game"])
        self._fake = codec.fake("evaluate.evaluate").make_evaluate(
            codec.build(ScoreSet, raw["scores"]), self.game
        )
        monkeypatch.setattr(replay, "load_player", self.load_player)
        monkeypatch.setattr(replay, "make_env", self.make_env)
        monkeypatch.setattr(replay, "evaluate", self.evaluate)

    def load_player(self, target: str, seed: int) -> tuple[dict[str, Agent], RunSettings]:
        self.loaded.append((target, seed))
        return self.agents, self.record.settings

    def make_env(self, settings: RunSettings) -> Callable[[], Env]:
        self.envs.append(settings)
        return self._no_env

    def _no_env(self) -> Env:
        raise AssertionError("the evaluate fake never builds an env")

    def evaluate(
        self, make_env: Callable[[], Env], agents: Mapping[str, Agent], spec: EvalSpec
    ) -> ScoreSet:
        assert make_env == self._no_env
        assert agents is self.agents
        self.specs.append(spec)
        return self._fake(make_env, agents, spec)


@pytest.mark.parametrize("index", [0, 2, 4])
def test_recorded_game_is_game_n_of_the_run(index):
    record = _record()

    picked = replay.pick_game(record, index, None)

    assert picked.seed == 1_000_000 + index
    assert picked is record.games[index]


@pytest.mark.parametrize("index", [5, -1])
def test_game_outside_the_recorded_ones_raises_naming_the_run(index):
    record = _record()

    with pytest.raises(IndexError, match=rf"corridor-tabular-s0.*no game {index} \(5 recorded\)"):
        replay.pick_game(record, index, None)


def test_new_seed_records_one_game_of_the_run_checkpoint(monkeypatch):
    record = _record()
    doubles = NewGameDoubles(monkeypatch, record)

    picked = replay.pick_game(record, 0, 7)

    assert picked is doubles.game
    assert doubles.loaded == [(str(record.path), 7)]
    assert doubles.envs == [record.settings]
    assert doubles.specs == [
        EvalSpec(player="corridor-tabular", train_seed=7, n_games=1, record=1)
    ]
    spec = doubles.specs[0]
    assert eval_seeds(spec.train_seed, spec.n_games) == [1_007_000]


def test_new_seed_ignores_the_game_index(monkeypatch):
    record = _record()
    doubles = NewGameDoubles(monkeypatch, record)

    picked = replay.pick_game(record, 99, 0)

    assert picked is doubles.game
    assert [s.train_seed for s in doubles.specs] == [0]
